name: Webflow Starter Site Free
free_limit: Free hosted Starter Site on a webflow.io subdomain: 2 static pages, 1 GB bandwidth and up to 50 form submissions; limited CMS features.
watch_out: Custom domains, additional pages, advanced features and ecommerce checkout require a paid Site plan; Webflow branding and Starter limits apply. Commercial-use terms for free Starter require provider confirmation.
